items.title: CVE-2026-48908: exploited vulnerability in JoomShaper SP Page Builder
items.note: JoomShaper SP Page Builder contains an unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability that allows unauthenticated users to upload arbitrary files, ultimately resulting in the upload and execution of PHP code.

items.title: CVE-2026-55255: exploited vulnerability in Langflow Langflow
items.note: Langflow contains an authorization bypass through user-controlled key vulnerability which allows an authenticated attacker to execute any flow belonging to another user by specifying the victim's flow ID in the request.

items.title: CVE-2026-56290: exploited vulnerability in Joomlack Page Builder
items.note: Joomlack Page Builder contains an improper access control vulnerability that could allow for remote code execution via unauthenticated arbitrary file upload.

items.title: CVE-2026-48282: exploited vulnerability in Adobe ColdFusion
items.note: Adobe ColdFusion contains a path traversal vulnerability that could lead to arbitrary code execution in the context of the current user.

items.title: CVE-2026-45659: exploited vulnerability in Microsoft SharePoint Server
items.note: Microsoft SharePoint Server contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability which allows an authorized attacker to execute code over a network.

items.title: CVE-2026-48558: exploited vulnerability in SimpleHelp  SimpleHelp
items.note: SimpleHelp contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the OIDC authentication flow. When OIDC authentication is configured, identity tokens submitted during login are accepted without verifying their cryptographic signature. In a vulnerable configuration, a remote, unauthenticated attacker can submit a forged token containing arbitrary identity claims to obtain a fully authenticated technician session. In some configurations, this may also allow bypass of multi-factor authentication.

items.title: CVE-2026-12569: exploited vulnerability in PTC Windchill and FlexPLM
items.note: PTC Windchill and FlexPLM contains an improper input validation vulnerability allowing an unauthenticated, remote attacker to execute arbitrary code by sending a malicious request to the network.

items.title: CVE-2026-20230: exploited vulnerability in Cisco Unified Communications Manager
items.note: Cisco Unified Communications Manager (Unified CM) and Cisco Unified Communications Manager Session Management Edition (Unified CM SME) contain a server-side request forgery (SSRF) Vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to write files to the underlying operating system that could be used later to elevate to root.

items.title: CVE-2025-67038: exploited vulnerability in Lantronix EDS5000
items.note: Lantronix EDS5000 contains a code injection vulnerability that could allow attackers to inject arbitrary OS commands into the username parameter. Injected commands are executed with root privileges.

items.title: CVE-2026-34910: exploited vulnerability in Ubiquiti UniFi OS
items.note: Ubiquiti UniFi OS contains an improper input validation vulnerability which could allow a malicious actor with access to the network to conduct command injection.

items.title: CVE-2026-34909: exploited vulnerability in Ubiquiti UniFi OS
items.note: Ubiquiti UniFi OS contains a path traversal vulnerability which could allow a malicious actor with access to the network to access files on the underlying system that could be manipulated to access an underlying account.

items.title: CVE-2026-34908: exploited vulnerability in Ubiquiti UniFi OS
items.note: Ubiquiti UniFi OS contains an improper access control vulnerability which could allow a malicious actor with access to the network to make unauthorized changes to the system.

items.title: CVE-2026-20253: exploited vulnerability in Splunk Enterprise
items.note: Splunk Enterprise contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated user to create or truncate arbitrary files through a PostgreSQL sidecar service endpoint.

items.title: CVE-2026-48907: exploited vulnerability in Widget Factory Joomla Content Editor
items.note: Widget Factory Joomla Content Editor contains an improper access control vulnerability which could allow for upload and execution of PHP code via the creation of new editor profiles for unauthenticated users.

items.title: CVE-2026-54420: exploited vulnerability in LiteSpeed cPanel Plugin
items.note: LiteSpeed cPanel plugin contains a UNIX symbolic link (Symlink) following vulnerability that could allow a user with FTP or web shell access on a shared hosting server running CloudLinux/CageFS.

items.title: CVE-2020-24193: recently changed critical CVE
items.note: A SQL injection vulnerability in login in Sourcecodetester Daily Tracker System 1.0 allows unauthenticated user to execute authentication bypass with SQL injection via the email parameter.

items.title: CVE-2018-5353: recently changed critical CVE
items.note: The custom GINA/CP module in Zoho ManageEngine ADSelfService Plus before 5.5 build 5517 allows remote attackers to execute code and escalate privileges via spoofing. It does not authenticate the intended server before opening a browser window. An unauthenticated attacker capable of conducting a spoofing attack can redirect the browser to gain execution in the context of the WinLogon.exe process. If Network Level Authentication is not enforced, the vulnerability can be exploited via RDP. Addition

items.title: CVE-2020-25466: recently changed critical CVE
items.note: A SSRF vulnerability exists in the downloadimage interface of CRMEB 3.0, which can remotely download arbitrary files on the server and remotely execute arbitrary code.

items.title: CVE-2017-15681: recently changed critical CVE
items.note: In Crafter CMS Crafter Studio 3.0.1 a directory traversal vulnerability exists which allows unauthenticated attackers to overwrite files from the operating system which can lead to RCE.

items.title: CVE-2020-35276: recently changed critical CVE
items.note: EgavilanMedia ECM Address Book 1.0 is affected by SQL injection. An attacker can bypass the Admin Login panel through SQLi and get Admin access and add or remove any user.

items.title: CVE-2020-24841: recently changed critical CVE
items.note: PNPSCADA 2.200816204020 allows SQL injection via parameter 'interf' in /browse.jsp. Exploiting this issue could allow an attacker to compromise the application, access or modify data, or exploit latent vulnerabilities in the underlying database.

items.title: CVE-2021-27132: recently changed critical CVE
items.note: SerComm AG Combo VD625 AGSOT_2.1.0 devices allow CRLF injection (for HTTP header injection) in the download function via the Content-Disposition header.

items.title: CVE-2020-24913: recently changed critical CVE
items.note: A SQL injection vulnerability in qcubed (all versions including 3.1.1) in profile.php via the strQuery parameter allows an unauthenticated attacker to access the database by injecting SQL code via a crafted POST request.

items.title: CVE-2020-24914: recently changed critical CVE
items.note: A PHP object injection bug in profile.php in qcubed (all versions including 3.1.1) unserializes the untrusted data of the POST-variable "strProfileData" and allows an unauthenticated attacker to execute code via a crafted POST request.

items.title: CVE-2021-28860: recently changed critical CVE
items.note: In Node.js mixme, prior to v0.5.1, an attacker can add or alter properties of an object via '__proto__' through the mutate() and merge() functions. The polluted attribute will be directly assigned to every object in the program. This will put the availability of the program at risk causing a potential denial of service (DoS).

items.title: CVE-2017-17674: recently changed critical CVE
items.note: BMC Remedy Mid Tier 9.1SP3 is affected by remote and local file inclusion. Due to the lack of restrictions on what can be targeted, the system can be vulnerable to attacks such as system fingerprinting, internal port scanning, Server Side Request Forgery (SSRF), or remote code execution (RCE).

items.title: CVE-2021-36581: recently changed critical CVE
items.note: Kooboo CMS 2.1.1.0 is vulnerable to Insecure file upload. It is possible to upload any file extension to the server. The server does not verify the extension of the file and the tester was able to upload an aspx to the server.

items.title: Moody Bible Institute
items.source: Have I Been Pwned breach catalog
items.note: In June 2026, Moody Bible Institute was targeted by a ShinyHunters "pay or leak" extortion campaign. Over 2.3M unique email addresses and other personal data were later published publicly, including names, physical addresses, phone numbers, dates of birth and other information relating to donors, supporters, students and alumni.

items.title: Sysco

The data also contained largely corporate contact information including names, phone numbers, physical addresses, internal job titles, and customer feedback.

items.title: Data broker privacy watch
items.note: Recheck broker opt-out results every 30-90 days; many brokers repopulate data. Keep broker name, profile URL, date requested, and confirmation emails.

items.title: Unwanted software / bloatware watch
items.note: Watch for software that changes browser settings, injects ads, bundles unwanted offers, hides removal paths, exaggerates cleanup claims, or uses misleading install prompts.

items.title: Remote-access scam reminder
items.source: WireShield guidance from FTC/CISA-style scam prevention
items.note: Treat unexpected requests to install AnyDesk, TeamViewer, UltraViewer, RustDesk, or ScreenConnect as high risk, especially when paired with refunds, bank warnings, crypto, or gift cards.
